response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts ORDER BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: A NULL tradekind is not a trader type, so its transactions are excluded from the results and denominator.

alternatives.interpretation: Include traders with a NULL tradekind as an unknown-type group.
